title: Chat fast entry and promised date choices verified in CI
claim: The chat side of story S4.3 and the chat part of S7.1 are implemented and verified in CI on main: one message records a credit sale or payment in the active shop and the reply shows the balance; an unknown or ambiguous name is asked about before anything is written; the promised date is chosen once by one tap or typed; managers reverse after confirming; opening a shop, joining by invitation, switching shop and language work from chat. 30 hand mutations were each caught. Nothing was sent through the real Telegram API, and the reply time target NFR-001 was not measured. A deadlock between the update's transaction and shop creation was found by a test and fixed in the same change
